messages:
maria: Heads up — planning a KMS key rotation + VPC egress tightening for eu-west-1 dedicated clusters tonight 02:00 UTC. This will touch audit log encryption and one firewall rule (outbound to data-warehouse).

aj: :eyes: How long is the maintenance window? Any expected interruption to realtime inference?

maria: Target window 02:00-02:30 UTC. We expect no inference downtime — policy change is outbound-only and should be applied via rolling config to nodes. But if a node fails KMS decrypt for metrics blobs, it may drop traces.

sam: Which key ARN are we rotating to? Need to update Dedicated customers who pinned keys for Private deployments.

maria: New key: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/abcd-2026-rotate. We'll add a compatibility alias and grant decrypt to existing node roles. Plan: create new key -> add alias -> replicate grants -> rotate.

lee: Any IAM role changes required for the autoscaler or fleet-provisioner? They need kms:Decrypt on the new key.

maria: Yes — autoscaler role (infra-autoscaler@redwood) and node role (redwood-node) will get explicit grants. I'm attaching the minimal statement we'll add:

```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:DescribeKey"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/abcd-2026-rotate"
}
```

aj: Can we do a canary in eu-west-2 first? We have spare GPU capacity there and fewer Dedicated customers.

maria: We considered that, but the kubeconfig for eu-west-2 uses a different VPC and the audit logging pipeline is wired to a different S3 bucket with another key. Canary there won't validate the egress change to the warehouse which is eu-west-1 only.

sam: OK — plan B: small canary within eu-west-1, restricted to non-production clusters. Create a canary node-group with 2 g4dn-equivalent GPUs.

ops-bot: scheduled-change: firewall-rule-update (outbound: data-warehouse) queued for 1719805200 (02:00 UTC). Change ID: CHG-4521.

lee: Who's owning rollback if the canary shows KMS failures for metric decryption?

maria: I'll own rollback. Rollback steps in runbook: 1) remove new alias 2) re-add previous grants 3) revert firewall rule via terraform. I'll push runbook updates to /runbooks/security/kms-rotation.md now.

security-bot: audit-log: enabled object versioning + server-side-encryption on s3://redwood-audit-eu-west-1, retention 365 days.

aj: Need to notify finance — audit log retention costs will bump ~+€120/mo for eu-west-1 per table.

sam: Also add a filter in Console that surfaces nodes that fail KMS decrypt so SREs can triage quickly (log pattern: "KMSDecryptionError").

lee: Firewall rule snippet (terraform) for reference:
```hcl
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "outbound_to_dw" {
  type        = "egress"
  from_port   = 5432
  to_port     = 5432
  protocol    = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = ["10.10.20.0/24"] # data-warehouse
  description = "Allow nodes to reach warehouse for metrics ingestion"
}
```

maria: Timeline recap: 01:30 UTC — final preflight checks; 02:00 UTC — apply KMS alias + firewall change to canary node-group; 02:10 UTC — validate decrypts and audit objects; 02:15 UTC — expand to remaining non-prod clusters; 02:30 UTC — evaluate for prod. If anything looks off, rollback immediate.

aj: I'll be oncall during the window. Ping me in #incidents if anything spikes.

ops-bot: incident-create: INC-9872 created for monitoring KMS rotation (severity: low).

sam: Added a quick logquery to PagerDuty runbook: 
```
filter @message like /KMSDecryptionError/ | stats count() by cluster
```

lee: One more ask — can we opt the Dedicated customer "Acme Health" (vpc-id vpc-0a1b2c3d) out of the firewall tightening temporarily? They have compliance team worrying.

maria: Yes — we'll exclude their subnets from the terraform change with a one-off tfvar and add a note to the customer advisory. I'll cc @support to notify them.

maria: OK pushing final PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/1024 — please review quickly so we can stick to the window. :thumbsup:
